thread:
Zoe Kim: dropped a new concept 5 'health mini-bar' at the top of the network step  lightweight, single-line, shows aggregated worst-host state + quick actions. figma: https://figma.com/file/mini-bar

Omar Hussein: I like the reduced vertical noise. Q: when hosts disagree do we show the worst state or a blended summary? I'd vote worst-first so problems are visible.

Leah Park: worst-first too. copy idea for the bar label: 'Readiness bar' vs 'Host health' vs 'Cluster health'  leaning 'Host health' since it's explicit.

Lin Gomez: accessibility nits: the bar must be a live region (aria-live="polite") and include sr-only text like "Host health: Degraded; last checked 45s ago". also include non-color cues (icon + text).

Zoe Kim: thanks Lin. UX action set: small `Retry` icon button and a kebab `...` with `Diagnostics` and `Hosts list` options. `Diagnostics` should pre-populate host context.

Omar Hussein: API note: diagnostics link should hit `/api/support/diagnostics?hosts=<ids>&context=network-step` and return a JSON job id. front-end polls `/api/support/diagnostics/<id>` until ready. if clipboard allowed, auto-copy a short sharable URL.

Leah Park: copy variants for the condensed state (pick one): A) "Host health  Healthy  5 hosts" B) "Host health  1 issue  See" C) "Host health  Degraded  Retry". We'll test A vs B in research.

Lin Gomez: keyboard behavior: make the entire bar focusable (tabindex=0). Enter/Space opens the kebab menu. if the bar updates while focused, announce change via aria-live but don't move focus. the kebab should have aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded toggled.

Zoe Kim: visual: use a thin pill for the status (icon + word) and a muted count pill for host count. ensure contrast for the pill text meets 4.5:1. Also add an animated ring on Retry for in-flight checks.

Omar Hussein: Implementation: maintain per-host cached results with timestamps; the bar shows aggregated result from cache and exposes a small `refresh` microaction that runs cheap probes (TCP/DNS) for freshness. expensive probes only on explicit 'Diagnostics'. debounce refresh to 8s.

Leah Park: microcopy for errors: "Retry failed  Could not reach host. Check firewall or proxy." Keep it actionable and under 60 chars. add `Learn more` link to KB.

support-bot: ping  diagnostics endpoint available internally; notify when job complete. scheduled accessibility QA on 2026-06-02 15:00 UTC.

Zoe Kim: deliverables for this round: 1) pick header copy (Leah), 2) aria snippet & keyboard flow (Lin), 3) diagnostics API contract (Omar), 4) figma with retry animation and pill states (me). Will iterate after the accessibility QA. :sparkles:
